comment: ANCHOR: STATUS_CONSISTENCY_LQ1803_20261110 — LQ-20261107-1803: one document may not say two things about one run's health. BLOCK/DEGRADED/FAIL and a non-zero exit are downgraded through scripts/lib/status_consistency.py before any receipt is written, the Jobs projection and the quality column read the same decision, and scripts/sweep_status_contradictions.py lists any file that still disagrees.
